noaa_gfs.limitations: NOAA GFS regional 0.25° grid. Model initialization is not publication time. Sparse 12/24/48/72-hour samples and native accumulation intervals; never daily totals or observed rainfall. May share the underlying model with Open-Meteo.

data.qa_policy: Native missingness, finite/range checks and nonmissing quality index; no unsupported high-quality threshold or field-accuracy claim

imerg.limitations: NASA IMERG Early V07 regional precipitation estimate, 0.1°, half-hour interval, delayed publication. Never a rain gauge reading or instantaneous weather.

measurements.quality: Native fill/valid-range checks; model-assimilated estimate, not a local sensor

data.time_basis: CMR observation interval retained; native SMAP J2000/atomic time is not relabeled as UTC

smap.limitations: Latest available regional NASA SMAP soil-moisture estimate, 9 km, model assimilated, 0–5 / 0–100 cm layers. Normally multi-day delay; never measured inside your farm.

data.qa_policy: hls-v2-conservative.v1; reject bits 0..5, high aerosol, fill and out-of-range NDVI

native_metadata.Fmask description:
Bits are listed from the MSB (bit 7) to the LSB (bit 0): 
7-6    aerosol:
       00 - climatology
       01 - low
       10 - average
       11 - high
5      water
4      snow/ice
3      cloud shadow
2      adjacent to cloud
1      cloud
0      cirrus cloud

hls_ndvi.limitations: HLS-VI v2 numeric NDVI with conservative native Fmask QA at one 30 m point cell. Acquisition can be old; not a field mean or vegetation-health percentage.
